mapper.select: SELECT io.value AS score, io.observation_date FROM indicator_catalog ic JOIN indicator_observation io ON ic.id = io.indicator_id WHERE ic.code = 'CNN_FG' ORDER BY io.observation_date DESC LIMIT 8

SELECT ic.code, ic.name, io.value, io.observation_date FROM indicator_catalog ic JOIN indicator_observation io ON ic.id = io.indicator_id WHERE ic.code IN ('MARKET_MOMENTUM', 'STOCK_PRICE_STRENGTH', 'STOCK_PRICE_BREADTH', 'PUT_CALL_RATIO', 'VIX', 'JUNK_BOND_DEMAND', 'SAFE_HAVEN_DEMAND') AND io.observation_date = ( SELECT MAX(io2.observation_date) FROM indicator_observation io2 WHERE io2.indicator_id = ic.id ) ORDER BY ic.id
SELECT io.observation_date, io.value AS score FROM indicator_catalog ic JOIN indicator_observation io ON ic.id = io.indicator_id WHERE ic.code = 'CNN_FG' ORDER BY io.observation_date
